The '''Mask of the Mo Zing''' can be obtained from [[Vael]] inside [[Grothmar Wardowns]] (right outside of [[Longeye's Ledge]]) for 250 [[Superb Charr Carving]]s. It has an [[Item's Attribute]] +1 bonus.

==Dye==
Dye affects the entire mask. Pink dye will cause it to appear red.
{{dye chart}}

== Notes ==
[[Image:Mo_Zing_Mask_Beard_Clipping.jpg|thumb|Clipping with beard]]

* [[Vael]] will appear as a [[collector]] only after [[Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon]]. 
{{bug|The mask has several [[clipping]] issues, since it ''sticks'' to one's face. In particular, beards and earrings clip through the headgear.}}

== Trivia ==
* In Guild Wars, a [[Mo Zing]] is a masterless assassin. [[Zenmai]] is one such assassin.
* This headgear resembles the two pieces of cloth wrapped around the head [[Wikipedia:Ninja|ninja]]s wore as part of the [[wikipedia:Shinobi_shōzoku|ninja attire]] depicted in popular culture, although real world ninjas did not wear such outfits.
